{{Quote|Fine, I'm on level 1312. A holobooth at the corner of 12th and G.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]|<ref name="Catch a Jedi" />}}
'''Level 1312''' was one thousand three hundred and twelve levels from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] core, in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]]. It was just one level below [[Level 1313/Legends|Level 1313]].<ref name="Catch a Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Level 1312 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[To Catch a Jedi]]."<ref name="Catch a Jedi" />
